_comment: Elemental Reflex NPC thresholds, keyed by stable entity type id (never display names). An NPC's conventional attack is negated only when the player's level >= max(min_player_level, npc_level + level_margin, sea floor of 'sea'). ALL VALUES ARE PROVISIONAL (no source data existed); tune them through play. 'aura': the NPC's attacks carry Aura (always bypass). 'bypass': this NPC always bypasses. 'boss': classified as a boss (always bypasses). 'bypass_attacks': damage type ids from this NPC that always bypass. Override with config/grandline/elemental_reflex.json (same format).
